text: Free demo where you're a wizard cat against endless monster hordes.
You just dodge. The spells fire themselves.
After each wave you pick a card, and your build turns into giant fireballs, bouncing snowballs, or spinning swords.
Best part: late in a run, the whole screen turns into a light show.
There's a boss fight against a big winged demon too.
The catch? The arena is mostly flat sand, and it looks empty.
The demo is about eight hundred megabytes, in English and Chinese.
Think Vampire Survivors, starring a cat.
Worth a dip if you've ever wanted to be a very powerful cat.
